     name and address of the head office of the science and technology organization;
     reason for dissolution;
     time limit and procedures for contract liquidation and payment of debts of the organization (if any);
     time limits for debt payment and contract liquidity must not exceed 6 (six) months after the effective date of the dissolution decisions;

5. The dissolution decision shall be sent to creditors together with a notice of debt settlement plan (if any).
